groups.name: LocalLockBenchmarks
groups.description: In-process LocalLockService: a baseline uncontended acquire/release on a unique key, and a bounded contended scenario where N contenders execute-with-lock on one shared key (directional coordination-overhead signal, not throughput).

parameters.name: Contenders
parameters.description: Number of concurrent tasks contending for the single shared key in the contended case (2 or 8).

measurements.slaStandard: An uncontended in-process lock acquire/release is pure local coordination and should be a few microseconds at most.
An uncontended in-process lock acquire/release is pure local coordination and should be a few microseconds at most.

groups.name: LockComparisonBenchmarks
groups.description: Uncontended acquire/release and execute-with-lock on a unique key, comparing in-process LocalLockService against distributed RedisLockService (throwaway Docker Redis). Isolates per-operation lock cost.

measurements.slaStandard: An uncontended in-process lock acquire/release should be a few microseconds (no network).
A distributed Redis lock acquire/release is bounded by a network round-trip and should stay within a few milliseconds on a local network.
In-process execute-with-lock adds only local coordination and should stay in the low tens of microseconds.
Distributed execute-with-lock is bounded by Redis round-trips and should stay within a few milliseconds on a local network.

slo.target: <= 10 µs — An uncontended in-process lock acquire/release should be a few microseconds (no network).
<= 15 µs — In-process execute-with-lock adds only local coordination and should stay in the low tens of microseconds.
<= 5 ms — A distributed Redis lock acquire/release is bounded by a network round-trip and should stay within a few milliseconds on a local network.
<= 5 ms — Distributed execute-with-lock is bounded by Redis round-trips and should stay within a few milliseconds on a local network.
<= 10 µs — An uncontended in-process lock acquire/release is pure local coordination and should be a few microseconds at most.

name: lock
title: Locking
description: Distributed-lock primitives for Lyo.Lock: uncontended acquire/release and execute-with-lock for the in-process LocalLockService vs the distributed RedisLockService (throwaway Docker Redis), plus a bounded contended local scenario. Each operation uses a unique key (GUID) so cases are uncontended unless stated; the contended case measures coordination overhead under N contenders, not raw throughput.
